summary:
The 5-Day Ephesus, Pamukkale & Antalya Tour travels from Turkey’s Aegean region to the Mediterranean coast. Explore Ephesus and its Library of Celsus and Great Theatre, see the white travertine terraces of Pamukkale and ancient Hierapolis, then continue to Antalya for Kaleiçi Old Town, Roman landmarks and the Mediterranean waterfront.
Travel dates are flexible, and the itinerary can be adjusted when needed. We arrange selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, two domestic flights, airport transfers, entrance fees and all guided sightseeing included in the program.

itinerary.title: Fllight to Izmir & Ephesus tour
itinerary.text:
At 04:00, transfer to Istanbul Airport for your morning flight to Izmir at 07:00.
Upon arrival at 08:10, meet your guide and continue to Ephesus, one of the best-preserved Greco-Roman ancient cities in the world. Explore its marble streets, the magnificent Library of Celsus, and the impressive Great Theatre. The tour also includes visits to the sacred House of the Virgin Mary and the remains of the Temple of Artemis. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pamukkale tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces, known as the “Cotton Castle,” and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also enjoy swimming at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, Transfer to hotel. Overnight in Pamukkale.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Antalya
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, transfer to Denizli Bus Station.
Board the intercity coach to Antalya.
Approximate journey time: 4 hours
Upon arrival in Antalya, meet and transfer to your hotel.
Overnight in Antalya.

itinerary.title: Antalya Ancient Cities Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:00, depart for a full-day tour of Antalya and the ancient Pamphylia region. Visit the remarkable ancient cities of Side, Perge, and Aspendos, famous for their impressive Roman ruins, including the well-preserved theatres and the largest stadium in Asia Minor. Continue to the scenic Manavgat Waterfall before returning to the hotel. Overnight in Antalya.

itinerary.title: Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel in Antalya.
Transfer to Antalya Airport for your flight to Istanbul.
Upon arrival in Istanbul, meet at the airport and transfer to your hotel.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the Ephesus, Pamukkale & Antalya Tour?
faqs.a: The Ephesus, Pamukkale & Antalya Tour covers three of Turkey's most popular destinations: Ephesus, Pamukkale, and Antalya. You will explore the ancient city of Ephesus, visit Pamukkale's famous white travertine terraces and the ruins of Hierapolis, and discover Antalya's beautiful coastline, historic Old Town, and Mediterranean atmosphere. The tour includes 4 nights and 5 days of travel.

faqs.q: How much does the Ephesus, Pamukkale & Antalya Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,050 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, two domestic flights, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees, selected meals, airport transfers, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, hotel category, and availability.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in this itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes two domestic flights. These flights help reduce travel time between destinations, allowing you to maximize your sightseeing opportunities and enjoy a more comfortable travel experience.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 4 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near major attractions. All airport and hotel transfers are included throughout the tour.

faqs.q: Does the Ephesus, Pamukkale & Antalya Tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled sightseeing tours. As part of the small-group experience, your guide will provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise throughout the journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want to experience a combination of Turkey's ancient history, natural wonders, and Mediterranean charm. It offers an excellent introduction to some of the country's most famous attractions in a short timeframe.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: archaeological sites, historic districts, and areas with uneven terrain. Ephesus and Pamukkale involve moderate walking, but most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Ephesus, Pamukkale, and Antalya?
faqs.a: Highlights include the Library of Celsus and Great Theatre in Ephesus, the white travertine terraces and ancient city of Hierapolis in Pamukkale, and Antalya's charming Kaleiçi Old Town, scenic coastline, and beautiful Mediterranean views.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Ephesus, Pamukkale & Antalya Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the Ephesus, Pamukkale & Antalya Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can extend your stay in Antalya, upgrade hotel categories, add optional excursions, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
